description: WEAK ADMISSION, reproduction side: the counterpart of replication-signal in the other vocabulary, and the whole of the reproduction book until #155 replaces it. Anchored on purpose — a bare "reproduction of" matches animal breeding, social reproduction and epidemiological R₀ far more often than a reproduction study (8% precision over 15,440 corpus rows; 0 of 15 sampled bare hits were our sense, #137) — while these ten forms cost nothing and score better on the curated reproduction list. Patterns unchanged from v1, where the rule carried the id `phrase-reproduction`; renamed in the v2 rewrite so the bundle names rules by what they do (claim · signal · probe) rather than by how v1 implemented them.
